SlipLift brings Slip’s hallmark speed, safety, and simplicity to a broader set of dock operations without requiring changes to facilities, trailers, or IT infrastructure. SlipLift is a core architectural shift that decouples the robot from the payload. Customers get fast, repeatable load and unload times across more routes, without adding robots or complexity.” Slip Robotics introduced SlipBot to solve short-haul, high-frequency, closed-loop loading.
